verdicts.explanation: The paper's introduction states that glassy Li3OCl- and Na3OCl-based antiperovskites reach about 0.1 mS/cm at room temperature, citing refs 18-20, so the origin is literature_cited and the value, unit and temperature match. The mobile_ion value 'other' is loosely worded for a mixed Li/Na class, but the paper gives no contradicting value and all secondary fields are correctly null.

The introduction reports 0.2 mS/cm room-temperature conductivity for amorphous Li3OCl used as a matrix for Li6.75La3Zr1.75Ta0.25O12 garnet particles, citing refs 21-24, which matches the cited composite in ref 21's title. The origin is correctly literature_cited, and the Li mobile ion and Ta dopant are consistent with the composition. All secondary fields are correctly null.
